title: Four-variable p-adic L-functions for GSp(4) x GL(2)
author: Zheng Liu
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique—Mathématiques 13(2026),1029–1060; DOI10.5802/jep.342; published2026-05-22
difficulty_reason: Beyond the ordinary Hida-theory and Furusawa-integral prerequisites, the authored proof constructs a four-variable Eisenstein measure and a Bessel-period family, then compares the latter with Rankin–Selberg families through Yoshida lifts. The period comparison establishes a nonzero identity on families and uses Zariski-dense arithmetic specializations to determine the previously uncomputed Archimedean factor for vector weights. The complete interpolation formula depends on these source-local measure, period and specialization arguments, which exceed ordinary doctoral qualifying exercises.
